title: Nonnegativity of revealment
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $Omega$ be a finite input alphabet, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree on $n$ coordinates with a finite nonempty seed space and a probability law on its seeds, such that every seed-selected tree computes the same function. For any probability distribution $pi$ on $Omega$, the revealment of $T$ under the independent product input distribution is nonnegative.
